transcript: Having trouble planning your next trip? Maybe you don't know where to go on a trip, but you know what you'd like to do. You may want to go hiking on top of mountains, or skiing, or surfing and take sun on a beach, see lakes and rivers, museums, national parks, art galleries. Or maybe you want to do all those things in one trip. We know it's not easy to choose your perfect destination, especially when you have so many interests. That's why we created Travel Planner. Travel Planner helps you choose the best destination for your trip, based on the things you love to do. Get the best recommendations and directions for cities all over the world. Maps, images, and detailed information to plan your perfect trip. Share your trips on social media with your friends and family. So what are you waiting for? Plan your trip today with Travel Planner. Download Travel Planner app for iOS and Android.
